name: Nowstalgia

lead: Nowstalgia describes nostalgia for the recent past, such as the 2010s or the early 2020s, rather than distant decades. In style it means reviving looks from a few years ago.
It helps looks by giving a simple template: borrow a recognizable recent aesthetic and update it.

paras: People pull out or buy items and looks associated with the recent past and style them with current pieces.
Few risks; trends cycle quickly and recent items may feel dated to some.

chain: Pick an aesthetic from the recent past
angle.text: Nostalgic styling gives people a ready-made reference look. How it affects appearance depends on the pieces chosen.

lead: Nowstalgia is a term for nostalgia directed at the very recent past, applied to fashion and aesthetics as a trend of reviving styles from only a few years ago. It extends the long-standing idea of retro revivals, which Wikipedia notes are sometimes described as following a 20 to 40 year cycle, though scholars dispute that the cycle exists.[1]

Psychology research on nostalgia generally treats it as a positive emotion that is often triggered by loneliness or change and that is associated with a sense of meaning and social connection.[1] People who adopt nostalgic styles often cite those feelings.

paras: Nostalgia was once classed as a medical condition and is now studied as an emotion; researchers describe functions such as boosting social support and meaning.[1] Trend cycles, including an often-cited 20-year rule, have been argued for and against.[1]
